On Mon, Nov 29, 2027 at 09:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding Samantha's note. We need ops-level confirmation and a quick plan for the booth to ensure ADA compliance without redesigning the backwall. ...

Thanks — dug into the kit. Summary and proposed fixes:

- Monitor mount: originally planned for a 4" riser to meet cabling. We can switch to a flush VESA mount (0" riser) — estimated vendor swap cost: $120 (labor + small bracket).
- Top banner: current mockup reaches 8'4" from the finished floor. Inspector's concern is the banner support plates that stick up to 8'8" in a few spots. We will replace with low-profile plates and trim the support fin by 6" to ensure max installed height is 8'2".
- ADA: with the above changes the walking clearance will be 6' full width; no obstruction to the 36" ADA path. We still need your signed ADA compliance form for show records (attached ADA_certificate.pdf — please review, signature required).
- Crate/sequence impact: trimming the fin means an extra bag of connectors and a foam block; we should add these to crate #2. Updated crate plan attached (crate_staging_plan.xlsx).

Attachments: kiosk_spec_sheet_v2.pdf (updated measurements), crate_staging_plan.xlsx, ADA_certificate.pdf

Can implement changes if we sign-off by EOD Tuesday so shop can cut parts Wednesday. Vendor lead time is 48 hours from sign-off.

I'll prep a one-page exception packet in case show management insists, but I think with the lowered plates we won't need to file.

—Lauren
Senior Production Manager
Redwood Inference

Next steps:

- Lauren: send final specs to the vendor by 18:00 PT today.
- Marissa: I'll update the freight manifest and mark the crate sequence for priority unload (we'll be on the floor during the 08:00 priority window).

Thanks — we should avoid a permit hold with this plan.
